subject: Regarding your inquiry
body:
Dear Madam Morvan,

I refer to your recent inquiry concerning our Pro subscription offering. Pursuant to our discussion, I am pleased to confirm that the aforementioned plan is available at the list price of 1490 EUR. Please do not hesitate to contact the undersigned should you require any further clarification whatsoever.

Yours faithfully,
Account Management Department

subject: Pro plan price
body:
Hi Lina,

The Pro plan is 1490 EUR. Setup takes a day, and your team gets the weekly report in an hour instead of two days. Shall I send the order form today? I can call you tomorrow at 10 to go through it.

Best,
Camille

subject: Insight Pro!!!
body: Hi Lina!!! We are SO thrilled you are looking at Insight Pro! It is our most powerful, game-changing, best-in-class analytics platform and customers absolutely LOVE it, it is a total revolution for reporting, dashboards, alerts, everything, and honestly you will wonder how you lived without it!!! The price is 1490 EUR which is a fantastic deal. Let me know if you have any questions at all, any time, I am always here for you!!!

subject: Re: price
body: Lina, the price is in the brochure, 1490 EUR. If your dashboards were slow it is your setup, not our product. Tell me what you want to do.

subject: Insight Pro
body:
Hi Lina, thanks for your message. Insight Pro is 1490 EUR and gives you full API access and a streamlined onboarding workflow. Going forward we can also leverage our synergies to optimize your reporting cadence and ensure alignment across stakeholders. Would a call this week work to discuss next steps?

Camille
